stepExplanation:
The distance from the centre of Earth equals the radius plus the altitude:
$$r = R_{Earth} + h = 6.4 \times 10^6 + 400 \times 10^3$$
$$r = 6.4 \times 10^6 + 0.4 \times 10^6 = 6.8 \times 10^6 \text{ m}$$
stepTitle: Calculate the Distance from Earth's Centre
stepBody: Calculate the distance from Earth's centre to the satellite. Remember: r = R_Earth + altitude. Give your answer in metres.
